info.name: Vigil Parent Web
info.description:
## Vigil Parent Web — API Test Collection

### 🔑 Credentials & Environment
| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Base URL | `http://160-153-179-249.sslip.io` |
| Parent Email | `parent@vigil.com` |
| Parent Password | `Parent@1234` |
| Environment | **Vigil env** (`35304629-fa1bd18d`) |

> The collection pre-request script auto-refreshes `token` before every request using `POST /api/auth/login`. `parentId` is also captured automatically.
>
> ⚠️ If login returns **403**, the `parent@vigil.com` account may be unverified or suspended. Use the **Vigil Admin Panel** collection → "10. Update User Status" to activate the account.

---

### ✅ Fully Automated (no device required)

| Folder | Endpoints | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| **1. Auth** | Register, Login, Verify OTP, Forgot/Reset Password | Register creates `parent@vigil.com` (accepts 409 if exists); Login captures `token` + `parentId` |
| **2. Dashboard** | Get Child Profile, Get Children list | `childId` and `parentId` captured from login/children responses |
| **7. Geofencing** | Create Geo Zone | `geoZoneId` captured on creation |
| **11. Child Management** | Add Child, Get Children, Update Child, Delete Child | `childId` captured from Get/Add Child |

---

### 🔒 Requires Physical Paired Device (majority of collection)

The following endpoint groups require:
1. A real **Android device** with the Vigil Child App installed and running
2. A completed **device pairing flow** (generates `x-device-key` / `deviceKey`)
3. An active `childId` linked to the paired device

Without these, all monitoring endpoints return **401 Unauthorized**.

| Folder | Endpoints | Device Requirement |
|---|---|---|
| **3. Calls Monitoring** | Incoming, Outgoing, Missed calls, Call logs | `x-device-key` in headers |
| **4. SMS Monitoring** | All SMS, Inbox, Keyword search, SMS count | `x-device-key` in headers |
| **5. Gallery (Files)** | Get files, Get by type | `x-device-key` in headers |
| **6. Live GPS & Location** | Current location, History, Location count | `x-device-key` in headers |
| **7. Geofencing** | Toggle, Delete Geo Zone | `geoZoneId` from Create + device active |
| **8. Screen Time (Apps)** | Installed apps, App count | `x-device-key` in headers |
| **9. Contacts** | Get contacts, Contact count | `x-device-key` in headers |
| **10. Events / Calendar** | Get events, Event count | `x-device-key` in headers |

---

### ⚠️ Known Limitations
- **Rate limiting (429)**: Auth endpoints (`/api/auth/login`, etc.) are rate-limited. If the collection is run multiple times quickly, Login will return 429. Wait ~5 minutes before re-running.
- **geoZoneId for Toggle/Delete**: `geoZoneId` is only captured if Create Geo Zone (in this collection) runs and succeeds first within the same run.

---

### 🚦 Automation Status
- **Without paired device:** ~24% pass rate (auth + child management endpoints only)
- **With paired device + active childId + deviceKey:** ~85%+ expected pass rate

request.description:
Runs the day’s AI Behaviour Analysis for a child. Backend pulls that child’s SMS + call logs for `date`, maps them to the AI model format, calls the model (server-to-server), and returns the analysis.

**Auth:** parent JWT (Bearer {{token}}). Verifies the child belongs to you.

**Body:** `{ "date": "{{aiDate}}" }` — optional, defaults to today (IST).

**Verified 08 Jul 2026** with real seeded data (3 SMS + 2 calls) → returned wellness_score 99.4, band "good", + PDF report. A nightly cron (02:00 IST) also auto-runs this for every child’s previous day.

See the saved example response below for the exact shape.

response.name: 200 — Verified (3 SMS + 2 calls)

originalRequest.description:
Collects the child`s SMS + call logs for the given day, maps them into the AI service format, and runs the behaviour analysis.

**Auth:** parent JWT (Bearer token) + verifies the child belongs to you.

**Body:** `{ "date": "YYYY-MM-DD" }` — optional; defaults to TODAY (IST). Usually you analyse a completed day (yesterday).

**Response (data found):** `{ status:200, analyzed:true, date, smsCount, callCount, result:{ ...daily_intelligence } }` — result has wellness_score, wellness_band, executive_summary, dominant_emotions, concerning_findings, recommendations, relationships, top_priorities, longitudinal trends, overall_confidence.

**Response (no data that day):** `{ status:200, analyzed:false, message:"No SMS or call logs found..." }`.

NOTE: a **daily cron runs this automatically at 02:00 IST for every child`s previous day** — this endpoint is for on-demand / "Generate Report" button. Added 03 Jul 2026.

request.description:
